abstract: This is a single-center, single-arm, open-label clinical study of 177Lu-CTR-FAPI injection in the treatment of patients with advanced, metastatic solid tumors i.e. pancreatic cancer, to assess safety, radio-dosimetry, and efficacy per RESIST 1.1.
summary_ko: This is a single-center, single-arm, open-label clinical study of 177Lu-CTR-FAPI injection in the treatment of patients with advanced, metastatic solid tumors i.e. pancreatic cancer, to assess safety, radio-dosimetry, and efficacy per RESIST 1.1.
title: Clinical Study of 177Lu-CTR-FAPI In the Treatment of Patients With Advanced, Metastatic Solid Tumors
